The Crystal Nucleus is a location in the  Crystal Hollows, mainly used to deposit collected Gemstone Crystals from expeditions.

Tasks

When the player first enters  Crystal Nucleus, they will be greeted with the following message:

NEW AREA DISCOVERED!
 Crystal Nucleus
 
■ Place all Crystals at the statues.

Location

[edit | edit source]

The Crystal Nucleus is always in the middle of the  Crystal Hollows  512, Y, 512. Players can travel to main areas of the map using each of 4 quadrants, as well as the  Magma Fields directly below the platform. After the required Crystals (Jade, Amber, Amethyst, Sapphire, and Topaz) are delivered to their respective statues, a Crystal Nucleus Loot Bundle will appear in front of the vault opposite of the Topaz Crystal Statue.

Crystals will remain placed if you leave the game. They cannot be picked up once placed, nor can duplicate Crystals be obtained until all 5 Crystals are placed.

Loot

[edit | edit source]
  • Each Crystal Nucleus Bundle contains :
    • 14-19[1] pieces of random loot;
    • 1 of every Fine Gemstone found in the  Crystal Hollows (e.g., not including Opal, Onyx, Aquamarine, Citrine, and Peridot);
    • 800  HotM EXP. If the player is already Heart of the Mountain 10, this is replaced with a random amount between 2,000-7,000 of either  Mithril Powder or  Gemstone Powder.

The number of drops can be increased in the following ways, up to a range of 16-21 rolls with a 65% chance for a bonus roll:

  • by 1, using  Mole Pet;
  • by 1, using Diamond Essence Shop perk "High Roller";
  • by 1 at a 5%→50% chance, using the Bigger Box attribute ( Hideoncave Shard);
    • which can be boosted up to 1.20x, using the Echo of Boxes attribute ( Cuboa Shard),
      resulting in a 6%→60% chance from the Bigger Box attribute ( Hideoncave Shard);
      • which can be boosted up to 1.50x, using the Echo of Echoes attribute ( Tiamat Shard);
        resulting in a maximum multipler of 1.30x from the Bigger Box attribute ( Hideoncave Shard);
        resulting in a maximum chance range 6.5%→65% chance from the Bigger Box attribute ( Hideoncave Shard).

Using Bazaar Prices:

  • The cost of  1 Precursor Apparatus,  1 Jungle Key, and  1 Goblin Egg, minus the sell price of the guaranteed Fine Gemstones drops, means each run costs ??? coins.
  • The cost of 1 of each Automaton Part,  1 Jungle Key, and  1 Goblin Egg, minus the sell price of the guaranteed Fine Gemstones drops, means each run costs ??? coins.

RNG Meter

[edit | edit source]

The Crystal Nucleus RNG Meter increases the drop rate of certain items from the list below.

  • Placing all crystals at the Crystal Nucleus gains 1,000 Nucleus XP for the meter. Retroactive completions from before the release of the Crystal Nucleus RNG Meter grant 250 Nucleus XP rounded towards the nearest thousand.
  • Items in the Crystal Nucleus RNG Meter have predefined amounts of XP required to guarantee to roll.
  • The amount of XP is roughly based on drop chance. The XP values can be read in the list below.
  • When a bundle is rolled, the selected item has an increased weight with the following formula. If enough XP is stored within the Crystal Nucleus RNG Meter, the selected item is guaranteed to drop.
New Weight=Item Weight×(1+min⁡(2×Stored Crystal Nucleus XPRequired Crystal Nucleus XP,2))
  • The menu can be accessed through the SkyBlock Menu:
     SkyBlock Menu ——> Your Skills ——> Mining ——> Heart of the Mountain ——> RNG Meter

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Successfully rolling for any Flawless Gemstone from a Nucleus Loot Bundle is much more common than  Divan's Alloy, by combining their weights:
Item Weight Chance per Roll Chance per Bundle (16.5 rolls) Chance per Bundle (19.15 rolls)
 1 Any Flawless Gemstone 95 0.030923% (1 in 3,233.8 rolls) 0.510234% (1 in 196.0 bundles) 0.592181% (1 in 168.9 bundles)
 1 Divan's Alloy 17 0.005534% (1 in 18,071.3 rolls) 0.091305% (1 in 1,095.2 bundles) 0.105969% (1 in 943.7 bundles)
  • Contrary to popular belief, the RNG Meter's formula is indeed applied to all rolls.[2]
  • The Jasper and Ruby Crystals are not used to complete the Crystal Nucleus but may be used to forge their respective Perfect Gemstones.
  • The Crystal Nucleus is the only location in the  Crystal Hollows that generates at a set location.
  • The Fine Gemstones guaranteed at each crystal run ensure at least 179,200 Coins (by selling to NPCs) or ??? coins (by selling to the Bazaar).
  • The center is positioned at  513, Y, 513 and roughly encloses a space from  465, 64, 465 to  561, 188, 561, meaning it is not centered in the  Crystal Hollows.
  • Crystals used to be reclaimable after placing in the Crystal Nucleus. If no item was picked up from the Loot Bundle, players could swap lobbies and replace the last crystal, rolling for new rewards. This was known as Nucleus Rerolling.
  • It's possible to enter the Nucleus Vault by mining in through the top or from behind.
